_doc: ⚑ S192 — THE RECOMMENDATION, 2016 (Phase 5; his 'from early Internet Explorer to modern Chrome'). Vera's day has a new job: tag the network's new testimony video for the platform's Recommended. She PRODUCES, never moderates (S64's evidentiary law). The tags are the house vocabulary, and the explicit term is greyed 'not used in house style' — the documented route: organisations use euphemistic vocabulary ('same-sex attraction', 'sexual brokenness'…), and later audits found such terms surface providers where explicit terms surface critical information (his research SocialMedia_Deep.md §3: [D] vocabulary, [R] audits, [I] the routing in 2016). 'Preview as viewer' opens the platform's page in a Chrome-grammar window: the video, and Up next walking theology → pastoral advice → testimony in three steps (the research's own proposal, [S]/[I]), '84% match — recommended for you', and the end card — 'Does any of this sound familiar?' and 'Share your story' — a generic platform call to action here (⚑ S197: his visual archive dates CHANGED/#OnceGay's 'Share your story' campaign to the later 2010s, so 2016 does not borrow it). 2016 has NO moderation note: explicit platform rules against conversion-practice promotion come later (TikTok 2022 — the research, [D]); that paradox is 2026's. Every mark INVENTED (Streamline, the channels, the titles).
